about: Stage Workshop node-definition table (roadmap 5a). Owned by track C (UI 2 Logic workspace); track B's events.py emitter reads it. Keep it backward compatible: never rename or remove a node id or a pin name, add new ones instead.

A node: id (stable), category (event | flow | action | data), label, docs, owners (which graph owners may use it: volume = trigger volume or script object, pad = teleport pad, native = a native SET object, stage = the stage graph, any = all), exec {in: [pin names], out: [pin names]} (white execution pins: they define the order), inputs / outputs (typed data pins), widgets (inline values on the node; an input pin with the same name as a widget overrides it when linked), v3 (how the node compiles to the CURRENT sidecar v3 / events.py graph, or null), vm (true = runs in the bytecode VM of roadmap 5b: the server builds every graph into sidecar v4 when the project uses one; v3 fields are still written for the rest).

Pin types: exec, bool, number, vector, object, string, any (reroute only). A data input takes one link; an exec output may fan out to several inputs, which run in the order of the links (the same as a v3 'next' edge to several nodes).

GRAPH SHAPE (plain JSON stored in the project next to its owner; an AI agent may write it directly): owner.logic = {version: 1, nodes: [{id: 'n1', type: '<node id>', x: 40, y: 60, values: {<widget>: <value>}, collapsed: false, title: null}], links: [{id: 'l1', from: 'n1', out: '<output or exec-out pin>', to: 'n2', in: '<input or exec-in pin>'}], groups: [{id: 'g1', title: 'Boost', x: 0, y: 0, w: 400, h: 200, colour: '#7c8aa5'}]}. Owners: a trigger volume or script object (project.triggers[i].logic), a teleport pad or native object (project.objects[i].logic), the stage (project.logic). Object references (widgets of type object) hold the target's id (placement id).

Compilation today (UI 2, mirrored by events.py v3): each event node and the exec chain after it become the owner's v3 fields. Volume: exactly one event node -> trigger.event / once / cooldown + trigger.graph {nodes: [{id, type: event|condition|action|delay, x, y, ...}], edges: [{from, to, port: next|true|false}]} + trigger.actions (the same chain flattened). Native: every event node -> one entry of object.events [{event, once, cooldown, actions, graph}]. Teleport pad: On touch -> Teleport player to -> pad.target + pad.cooldown. Stage graphs and vm nodes build into sidecar v4 (track B's compiler, track A's VM): owners in the v4 node table are 'stage', 'volume:<id>', 'pad:<id>', 'native:<id>'; live highlight ids are '<owner>/<node id>'. Flow.sequence and flow.reroute are pass-through in v3.
Live values usable in Branch: @rings @score @lives @hero_score @dark_score @stage_time @player_y @speed (read-only); other names are stage variables set by Set variable.

needs (optional): 'runtime' = the node is defined and drawn but the game has no code for it yet (track A); the build leaves it out (the chain goes on) and names it in the build warnings. Nodes without 'needs' build.
templates: ready graphs the Logic workspace inserts (Templates button): {id, label, owners, docs, graph}; ids are renamed on insert. Only nodes that build today are used.

nodes.label: On enter
nodes.docs: The player enters this volume.

nodes.label: On exit
nodes.docs: The player leaves this volume.

nodes.label: While inside
nodes.docs: Repeats while the player stays inside, once per cooldown.

nodes.label: On interact
nodes.docs: The player presses the action button inside this volume.

nodes.label: On touch
nodes.docs: A teleport pad is touched. In v3 a pad can only teleport (connect Teleport player to).

nodes.label: On spawn
nodes.docs: The object comes into range and is created (repeats each time unless Only once).

nodes.label: On killed
nodes.docs: The object is destroyed by the player and stays dead.

nodes.label: On removed / collected
nodes.docs: The object is removed, collected or used (rings, boxes, items).

nodes.label: On despawn
nodes.docs: The object goes out of range and is unloaded.

nodes.label: Stage start
nodes.docs: Runs once when the player becomes active.

nodes.label: Every N seconds
nodes.docs: Repeats on a timer (simulation seconds, the same at any frame rate).

nodes.label: On custom event
nodes.docs: Runs when Send custom event fires with the same name.

nodes.label: Branch
nodes.docs: Compares a stage variable or live game value with a number and continues on True or False.

nodes.label: Delay
nodes.docs: Waits, then continues. In v3 the waits along a chain add up from the event (max 3600 s).

nodes.label: Sequence
nodes.docs: Runs Then 0, Then 1, ... in order.

nodes.label: Reroute
nodes.docs: A dot to tidy wires; passes exec or data through.

nodes.label: Do once
nodes.docs: Lets the first run through, blocks later ones until Reset.

nodes.label: Gate
nodes.docs: Passes Enter through only while open (Open / Close / Toggle).

nodes.label: Counter
nodes.docs: Counts runs; continues on Reached when the count reaches the target.

nodes.label: Wait until
nodes.docs: Pauses this chain until the condition is true.

nodes.label: Random branch
nodes.docs: Continues on A or B with the given chance of A.

nodes.label: Teleport player to
nodes.docs: Moves the player to a placement's position.

nodes.label: Set speed
nodes.docs: Sets the player's velocity (units per second; z negative = forward on most stages).

nodes.label: Give rings
nodes.docs: Adds (or with a negative number removes) rings.

nodes.label: Add score
nodes.docs: Adds points to the score.

nodes.label: Set variable
nodes.docs: Sets a stage variable (read by Branch). Names starting with @ are read-only game values.

nodes.label: Enable volume
nodes.docs: Turns a trigger volume (or an object event) on.

nodes.label: Disable volume
nodes.docs: Turns a trigger volume (or an object event) off.

nodes.label: Lighting trigger on / off
nodes.docs: Turns a named lighting trigger on or off (sidecar action 6 -> lighting::set_environment_trigger). Lighting rules with that trigger (a region's Trigger, a lighting profile, lighting_profiles.ini trigger=) apply while it is on and blend over their transition seconds (0-30). All triggers reset when a stage loads; at most 64 at a time.

nodes.label: Set lighting profile
nodes.docs: Turns a lighting profile on (or off) by its trigger name: Stage settings -> Lighting profiles (rules with no bounds) or a lighting region with that Trigger (only inside its box). The same sidecar action 6 as Lighting trigger; the profile blends in over its Blend seconds. The highest priority wins where several apply.

nodes.label: Fade sun
nodes.docs: Fades the sun to Strength (0-3; 1 = the stage's sun) over Seconds. Builds a lighting rule of its own (trigger ws_fade_sun_<owner>_<node>, sun_strength, transition = Seconds, high priority) that this node turns on with action 6. Undo it with Lighting trigger off and that name, or another Fade sun. Runtime limits: the rule changes sun_strength only; the sun direction / tint need a lighting profile.

nodes.label: Send custom event
nodes.docs: Fires On custom event nodes with the same name.

nodes.label: Spawn object
nodes.docs: Creates a copy of a template: a native object (SET record) placed in this project, usually a hidden pool placement (activation distance 0), at Position. Spawned outputs the new object (for Move / Destroy). The build refuses a template that is not a native record.

nodes.label: Destroy object
nodes.docs: Removes a live native object (one placed in this project, or one Spawn made).

nodes.label: Move object
nodes.docs: Moves a live native object to To (x, y, z) over Seconds (0 = at once).

nodes.label: Log message
nodes.docs: Logs the text (on-screen text needs the HUD research).

nodes.label: Self
nodes.docs: The placement that owns this graph.

nodes.label: Placement
nodes.docs: A reference to one placement of this stage.

nodes.label: Number
nodes.docs: A constant number.

nodes.label: Vector
nodes.docs: A constant x, y, z.

nodes.label: Text
nodes.docs: A constant text.

nodes.label: Game value
nodes.docs: A live game value (rings, score, speed...) as a number.

nodes.label: Get variable
nodes.docs: A stage variable's current value.

nodes.label: Compare
nodes.docs: A op B as true / false.

nodes.label: Math
nodes.docs: A op B.

nodes.label: Player position
nodes.docs: Where the player is.

nodes.label: Object position
nodes.docs: Where a live object is (roadmap 5c).

nodes.label: For loop
nodes.docs: Runs Body Count times (Index 0, 1, 2 ...), then Completed. Each pass starts one frame after the last; a Delay inside the body does not hold the loop (the passes overlap).

nodes.label: While loop
nodes.docs: Runs Body once a frame while the condition is true (at most Max passes), then Completed.

nodes.label: Add to variable
nodes.docs: Adds Amount to a stage variable (negative = subtract). Counters, combos, lives of your own.

nodes.label: And
nodes.docs: True when both are true (not 0).

nodes.label: Or
nodes.docs: True when either is true (not 0).

nodes.label: Not
nodes.docs: True when A is false (0).

nodes.label: Random number
nodes.docs: A random number from Min to Max (a new one every time it is read).

nodes.label: Start timer
nodes.docs: Starts (or restarts) a named countdown of Seconds on the stage clock. Read it with Timer left; wait for it with Wait for timer.

nodes.label: Timer left
nodes.docs: Seconds left on a named timer (0 when done or never started).

nodes.label: Wait for timer
nodes.docs: Pauses this chain until the named timer reaches 0.

nodes.label: Show text
nodes.docs: Big text on the screen for Seconds (a title, a hint, a countdown). Shown in the centre (Where is not used yet).

nodes.label: Show value on HUD
nodes.docs: Keeps "Label: value" of a variable on the screen (a kill count, a timer) until the Hide input runs.

nodes.label: Complete mission
nodes.docs: Completes the route's mission the game's own way (finish pose, results screen).

nodes.label: Fail mission
nodes.docs: Fails this route's mission the way the game does: that route cannot be completed any more. The stage keeps running (no failed screen); the Reason shows on screen first.

nodes.label: Play sound
nodes.docs: Plays a sound once: an imported sound effect (WAV / OGG / ADX - the build converts it to WAV). Game cue names are not playable yet.

nodes.label: Open link group
nodes.docs: Triggers every object with this Link ID, like the game's own trigger objects (a Digital Breakable Tile appears, a gate opens).

example.about: A complete owner.logic graph for a trigger volume (the four-scenario test project's 'Ring zone'): when the player enters (once), if @rings == 0, give 33 rings; a Vector constant drives a Set speed after a 0.5 s delay through a reroute. Paste it in the Logic workspace (Import JSON) on any trigger volume; Export JSON shows the same shape for an existing graph.
rules: Exec wires (out pins of exec type: then / true / false / then N) go to an exec in pin (exec). An exec output may fan out to several inputs; they run in link order.

A data wire goes from an output pin to an input pin of the same type (number, vector, object, string, bool); a reroute ('in' / 'out', type any) takes the type of what it is wired to. A data input takes one wire; a wired input overrides the widget of the same name.
values hold widget values by widget name; object widgets hold a placement id; missing values take the widget default.

Per owner kind: a trigger volume uses exactly one of event.enter / exit / stay / interact (v3); a teleport pad event.touch -> action.teleport only; a native object any of event.spawn / killed / removed / despawn (one object event each); nodes with vm: true are saved but only build once the VM (roadmap 5b) lands.
Ids: any unique strings; the editor uses n1, n2 ... for nodes, l1 ... for links, g1 ... for groups.

templates.label: Combo bonus
templates.docs: Each time the player passes through, +1 combo; at 5 a 1000 point bonus and the combo starts again.

templates.label: Countdown challenge
templates.docs: A 60 second clock from the stage start; when it runs out the message shows (Show text / Fail mission come with the runtime).

templates.label: Enemy wave
templates.docs: On "wave 1" three hidden pool enemies spawn (choose them: native enemies placed with activation 0); each enemy's own graph sends "enemy down" when killed (On killed -> Send custom event); 3 downs send "wave 2".

templates.label: Random reward
templates.docs: Every 15 seconds: half the time 10 more rings, else 500 points.

templates.label: Repeat N times
templates.docs: A For loop: the body runs Count times, one pass a frame, then Completed.

templates.label: Kill counter
templates.docs: On this enemy: when it is killed, +1 to the stage variable "kills" and "enemy down" for a wave counter.
